```{r Libraries, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='markup'}
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggthemes)
library(ggpmisc)
library(broom)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(rlang) 
library(tigris)
library(forcats)
library(sf)
library(viridis)
```


```{r Read in data}

homicides_stl <- read_csv("homicide-data.csv") %>% 
  mutate(city_name = paste(city, state, sep = ", ")) %>% 
  filter(city == "St. Louis", 
         !is.na(lat)) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"), 
           crs = 4326)
```


```{r}
homicides_stl <- homicides_stl %>%  
  mutate(
    disposition = case_when(disposition %in% c("Closed without arrest", "Open/No arrest") ~ "unsolved", 
                            disposition %in% c("Closed by arrest") ~ "solved"))

## placing races into four catagories 
homicides_stl <- homicides_stl %>%  
  mutate(
    victim_race = case_when(victim_race %in% c("Asian", "Other") ~ "other", 
                            victim_race %in% c("White") ~ "White", 
                            victim_race %in% c("Black") ~ "Black", 
                            victim_race %in% c("Hispanic") ~ "Hispanic"))

# STL tracts
stl_tracts <- tracts(state = "MO", county = "510", cb = TRUE, class = "sf") 

# STL subdivisions 
stl_subdivisions <- county_subdivisions(state = "MO", county = "510", cb = TRUE, class = "sf")

# Major roads 
stl_roads <- roads(state = "MO", county = "510", class = "sf")
  
delmar <- stl_roads %>%  filter(FULLNAME == "Delmar Blvd")

major_roads <- stl_roads %>% filter(MTFCC %in% c("S1100", "S1200"))

```



```{r plot}
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = stl_tracts) + 
  geom_sf(data = major_roads) +
  geom_sf(data = delmar, color = "red", size = 2) +
  geom_sf(data = homicides_stl, aes(color = victim_race), alpha = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ disposition, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(name = "Status of Homicide Cases in St. Louis, MO", 
                     values = c(
                     "Black" = "orange", 
                     "White" = "blue", 
                     "Hispanic" = "darkgreen", 
                     "other" = "pink")) +
  theme_dark() +
  labs(
    title = "Homicides in St. Louis, MO", 
    caption = "Red line = Delmar Divide"
  )

```
